item.title: Central Bank of India Q2 profit rises 21% as loans grow 30%
item.description: Central Bank of India reported a 21% rise in September 2026 quarterly net profit to Rs 1,469 crore, supported by 26% net interest income growth and 30% loan expansion. Asset quality improved, with net NPA declining to 0.31%, while operating efficiency strengthened.

item.title: ixigo Q2 profit at Rs 63 cr on robust show in hotel booking biz
item.description: Ixigo reported a remarkable turnaround with a consolidated net profit of Rs 63.42 crore for the September quarter, bouncing back from a net loss of Rs 3.46 crore from last year. The surge in hotel bookings played a key role in this financial upswing, leading to operational revenue of Rs 320.96 crore.

item.title: ICICI Bank Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 20% YoY to Rs 14,843 crore, NII rises 18%
item.description: ICICI Bank Q2 Results: Private lender ICICI Bank reported a net profit of Rs 14,843 crore in the second quarter of financial year 2027, marking 20.1% year-on-year increase from Rs 12,359 crore posted in the same period last year.

item.title: IDBI Bank Q2 results: Net profit tanks 39% YoY to Rs 2,205 crore; NII dips 49% YoY
item.description: IDBI Bank reported a 39% year-on-year profit decline to Rs 2,205 crore in Q2 FY27, impacted by a one-off gain in the previous year. Excluding this, profit rose 14%. Asset quality improved, deposits grew 17%, advances increased 18%, and net interest margins strengthened sequentially to 4.11%.

item.title: Nifty reclaims 200 WMA; eyes further gains as key resistance shapes next move
item.description: Indian equity markets rebounded 2.78%, with the Nifty reclaiming its crucial 200-week moving average. However, weak momentum indicators and overhead resistance warrant caution. Banking, metal, media, pharma and IT stocks show relative strength. Investors should monitor key support levels, prioritise fundamentally strong stocks and maintain disciplined risk management strategies.

item.title: 10 smallcap stocks surge up to 65% in 3 months despite market weakness
item.description: Despite a nearly 4% decline in the Nifty 50 over three months, several Nifty Smallcap 250 stocks have rallied sharply. Cupid led with 66% gains, followed by Sterlite Technologies and Welspun Corp, highlighting pockets of resilience amid market volatility.

item.title: HDFC Bank Q2 Results: Net profit rises 5% YoY to Rs 19,510 crore; NII grows 10%
item.description: HDFC Bank Q2 Results: India’s largest private lender HDFC Bank on Saturday reported a net profit of Rs 19,509 crore for the second quarter of FY27, marking a 4.6% year-on-year jump from Rs 18,641 crore posted in the same period last year.

item.title: Axis Bank Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 38% YoY to Rs 7,003 crore, NII rises 12%
item.description: Axis Bank Q2 Results: Private lender Axis Bank on Saturday reported a net profit of Rs 7,003 crore for the second quarter of FY27, marking a jump of 38% from Rs 5,089 crore posted in the corresponding quarter of the previous financial year.

item.title: 8 small, midcap stocks with upside potential of up to 50%. How many are in your portfolio?
item.description: PL Capital remains cautious after the Nifty’s eight-week losing streak, warning against expectations of a V-shaped recovery. Despite market uncertainty, the brokerage favours eight small and midcap stocks, including CESC, Amber Enterprises and Healthcare Global, citing potential upside of 13-50%.

item.title: Nicholas Sleep’s investing lessons: Why patience, conviction and long-term thinking matter
item.description: Nicholas Sleep’s investment philosophy emphasises independent thinking, patience, and understanding business fundamentals. His successful Nomad Investment Partnership demonstrated the value of identifying high-quality businesses, assessing sustainable competitive advantages, and focusing on long-term value rather than daily price movements. He advocated disciplined research, selective diversification, emotional control, continuous learning, and adapting decisions when circumstances change.

item.title: Concurrent Gainers: 15 stocks gain for 5 days in a row
item.description: The Sensex gained 3.11% during October 12–16, while 15 BSE 500 stocks posted consecutive gains. Tata Elxsi led with 23%, followed by KPIT Technologies at 16%.

item.title: Why India's steel demand is defying global weakness
item.description: India’s steel prices are rising despite weak global markets, supported by infrastructure spending, manufacturing growth and higher input costs. While Chinese oversupply pressures international prices, robust domestic consumption and capacity utilisation underpin India’s outlook, with cheaper imports remaining a key risk.

item.title: IT's time to celebrate when chips are down; Nifty IT soars 11.7% to log biggest weekly rally since 2008
item.description: The Indian IT sector experienced an impressive surge, achieving its highest weekly increase in 18 years, driven by unexpectedly strong quarterly results from companies like HCLTech. The Nifty IT index jumped 11.7%, amidst falling semiconductor stock prices in Asia. Furthermore, the rupee showed notable strength, closing below the 95-mark for the first time in 38 days, reflecting the effective measures implemented by the Reserve Bank of India.

item.title: Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals Ltd Q2 Results: Profit surges 65% to Rs 124 crore
item.description: Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals reported a 65 percent increase in consolidated net profit for the September quarter. The company's revenue from operations also jumped by 18.15 percent compared to the previous year. Significant revenue growth was achieved in the electric consumer durable segment, especially in fans and appliances. Overall, the company's total income surged by 18.24 percent in the same period.

item.title: DLF Q2 profit rises to Rs 1,301 crore as luxury project sells out
item.description: DLF reported a 11% year-on-year increase in July-September net profit to Rs 1,301 crore, with sales bookings reaching Rs 3,800 crore. Its Aureva luxury retirement project in Gurugram sold out, while the company maintained a strong net cash position.

item.title: Ujjivan SFB to raise Rs 409 crore from IFC, three insurers
item.description: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank plans to raise Rs 409 crore through a preferential share allotment to IFC and three insurers at Rs 64.73 per share. The bank also reported a 200% year-on-year jump in Q2 net profit to Rs 365 crore.

item.title: Federal Bank Q2 profit jumps 45% to record Rs 1,386 crore
item.description: Federal Bank posted record Q2 profit of Rs 1,386 crore, up 45% year-on-year, as net interest income climbed 26%. Advances grew 22% and deposits 19%, while asset quality improved, with gross NPAs declining to 1.32% during the September quarter.

item.title: Kotak Mahindra Bank among 5 stocks that hit 52-week highs & rallied up to 15% in a month
item.description: Five BSE 500 stocks—Shyam Metalics, PVR Inox, Kotak Mahindra Bank, Indian Hotels and Laurus Labs—hit fresh 52-week highs as the Sensex gained 413 points. All five stocks posted monthly gains of around 8% to 15%, signalling positive momentum.

item.title: LTM Q2 Results: PAT remains flat at Rs 1,380 crore; revenue rises 14% YoY; co declares Rs 25 per share dividend
item.description: LTM reported a marginal 0.1% decline in Q2 FY27 profit to Rs 1,379.9 crore, while revenue rose 13.6% to Rs 11,807.6 crore. Enterprise AI and Business AI revenue grew 47%, and the company declared an interim dividend of Rs 25.

item.title: Bajaj Housing Finance Q2 Results: PAT rises 18% YoY to Rs 757 crore, AUM grows 25%
item.description: Bajaj Housing Finance reported an 18% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 profit to Rs 757 crore, while net interest income increased 10%. Assets under management grew 25% to Rs 1.58 lakh crore, with asset quality remaining largely stable.

item.title: Urban Company Q2 Results: Loss widens to Rs 182 crore; revenue jumps 41% YoY
item.description: Urban Company reported a net loss of Rs 182 crore in Q2FY27 as investments in its quick services business, InstaHelp, weighed on profitability. Revenue rose 41% year-on-year to Rs 537 crore, while orders grew 103%. The company also approved a fresh capital raise of up to Rs 2,500 crore, subject to shareholder approval.

item.title: Market wrap: Tech Mahindra, TCS, InterGlobe, BSE top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Friday
item.description: Indian equities extended gains as strong IT earnings lifted sentiment, with the Nifty rising 149 points to 23,146 and Sensex gaining 413 points. Tech Mahindra led advances, while broader markets slipped. Analysts flagged 23,000 as crucial for further upside.

item.title: Yes Bank Q2 preview: Will strong profit, NII growth offer relief for investors amid AT-1 bond saga?
item.description: Yes Bank is expected to post a 48% YoY jump in Q2 net profit to Rs 969 crore, driven by robust loan growth and higher NII. However, investor focus remains on the Supreme Court ruling invalidating its Rs 8,415 crore AT-1 bond write-off, which has pressured the stock.

item.title: Laurus Labs shifts gears as CDMO emerges as key growth driver; Nuvama sees 24% upside
item.description: Nuvama Institutional Equities has initiated coverage on Laurus Labs with a ‘Buy’ rating and a target price of Rs 2,520, implying a 24% upside from the current market price. The brokerage expects the drugmaker’s shift from its traditional anti-retroviral (ARV) business towards contract development and manufacturing (CDMO) to drive its next phase of growth.

item.title: ICICI Bank Q2 Results Preview: PAT, NII may rise up to 21% YoY; margins, deposit growth in focus
item.description: ICICI Bank is expected to report 15.8-18% year-on-year growth in net interest income and 15-21% growth in profit after tax in Q2FY27, according to brokerage estimates. Investors will track net interest margins, loan and deposit growth, operating profitability and asset quality, with margin pressure and provisioning trends remaining key monitorables.

item.title: Mukesh Ambani taps massive Reliance workforce to boost Jio’s record IPO
item.description: Mukesh Ambani is mobilising Reliance Industries’ workforce to boost interest in Jio Platforms’ record IPO. The conglomerate has encouraged employees to consider investing, released October salaries early and set aside shares for eligible employees and Reliance shareholders.

item.title: 10 stocks held by 100+ MF schemes in September rally up to 205% in CY26; 6 turn multibaggers
item.description: Ten stocks held by over 100 mutual fund schemes gained 75% to 205% in CY26 through September. Six of these stocks more than doubled, led by Welspun Corp and MTAR Technologies.

item.title: From worst to best: How IT stocks staged a Rs 2.6 lakh crore revival this week
item.description: Indian IT stocks staged a sharp comeback this week, adding Rs 2.6 lakh crore in market value as the sector gained 12% to become the best-performing index. Better-than-expected Q2 earnings, positive management commentary and a selloff in AI-linked stocks helped revive sentiment, even as concerns over AI adoption and earnings growth persist.

item.title: Indian Bank reports a Rs 1,388 crore gain from sale of NSE shares
item.description: Indian Bank gained Rs 1,388 crore from the NSE listing, boosting second-quarter non-interest income by 50% to Rs 3,953 crore. The one-time gain offset pressure from rising bond yields, despite Rs 123 crore in mark-to-market losses. Meanwhile, Canara Bank and UCO Bank reported declines in other income, reflecting weaker treasury earnings.

item.title: Jio IPO GMP at 20%: Grey market signals Rs 220 premium as brokerages say subscribe
item.description: Jio Platforms IPO GMP today: Jio Platforms’ Rs 30,200 crore IPO has a grey market premium of Rs 220 ahead of its October 21 opening. Emkay Global and SBI Securities highlight its telecom leadership, earnings growth and digital expansion, while flagging valuation, regulatory and capital expenditure risks.

item.title: HFCL’s AI, data centre exposure drives Nuvama’s Buy call; target implies 56% upside
item.description: Nuvama has initiated coverage on HFCL with a ‘Buy’ rating and a target price of Rs 380, implying a 56% upside from its reference price of Rs 244. The brokerage expects the company’s shift towards telecom and networking products, along with rising demand from data centres and exports, to drive earnings growth.

item.title: Indonesia’s $1.5 trillion market faces a historic downgrade: Why global investors are worried
item.description: Indonesia’s $1.5 trillion stock market plunged after MSCI warned that its emerging-market classification may no longer be appropriate, raising fears of billions of dollars in foreign outflows. Concerns over market transparency, opaque shareholding structures and policy credibility have intensified investor anxiety, with Indonesian equities down nearly 40% in 2026.

item.title: PC Jeweller, Shanti Gold & other jewellery stocks rally up to 10%. Here's why
item.description: Jewellery stocks, including Shanti Gold International, PC Jeweller and Sky Gold and Diamonds, rose sharply on Friday as mutual fund houses temporarily restricted fresh subscriptions to gold ETF Fund of Funds. With the festive and wedding season approaching, analysts expect resilient gold demand, while organised retailers could benefit from market share gains.

item.title: Persistent Systems shares slide 5% despite Q2 revenue growth. Buy, sell or hold?
item.description: Persistent Systems shares fell 5% despite 7.8% sequential constant-currency revenue growth in Q2FY27, as margin contraction and a sharp decline in profit weighed on sentiment. Brokerages remained divided on the stock amid valuation concerns and acquisition-related costs.

item.title: Why are markets rising today? Sensex settles 400 pts higher, Nifty gains for 2nd day. 4 factors behind the surge
item.description: On Friday, benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty extended their gains for a second consecutive session. IT stocks, which rose significantly, contributed to the market rally alongside gains in auto, metal, and PSU banking stocks. Additionally, US bond yields fell, enhancing the appeal of Indian equities for foreign investors. Meanwhile, oil prices eased despite ongoing tensions, leading to expectations of reduced global freight rates.

item.title: New CAS rules decoded: What Sebi’s revised framework means for stock market traders
item.description: Sebi has revised the Closing Auction Session (CAS) framework after receiving more than 20,000 comments from stakeholders. The updated rules introduce a 10-minute closing auction, restore the VWAP method for F&O expiry settlement prices and clarify order transfers. Most changes will take effect on December 7, 2026.

item.title: Karur Vysya Bank shares rally 6% after Q2 profit jumps 37% YoY
item.description: Karur Vysya Bank shares rose sharply after the private sector lender reported a 37% year-on-year rise in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 788 crore. Net interest income grew 19% to Rs 1,497.3 crore, while total business increased nearly 18% to Rs 2.40 lakh crore.

item.title: HDFC Bank Q2 results preview: PAT, NII may rise up to 9% YoY; deposit growth in focus
item.description: HDFC Bank is set to unveil its Q2 results on October 17, 2026, showcasing key financial indicators. Analysts predict a year-on-year rise in net interest income of about 8%, driven by an increase in loans. Profit after tax forecasts vary among brokerages, reflecting a range of expectations regarding the bank's financial health.

item.title: Beyond Titan and Kalyan: Analysts pick these jewellery stocks as potential market winners. Do you own any?
item.description: As the festive season approaches, India's gems and jewellery sector braces itself for an influx of consumer demand. Analysts believe that sustained purchases tied to weddings could boost sales, even amid rising gold prices. While Titan Company and Kalyan Jewellers remain prominent, Senco Gold and Lalithaa Jewellery Mart are capturing investor interest.

item.title: Persistent Systems among 4 F&O stocks with a sharp rise in futures open interest
item.description: Persistent Systems, Ujjivan Small Finance Bank, Siemens Energy India, and Nestle India recorded futures open interest increases exceeding 11% on October 15, indicating heightened derivatives market activity.

item.title: Wipro shares rise over 2% as Q2 revenue grows 9% YoY. What are Nomura, Goldman Sachs analysts saying?
item.description: Wipro reported a 9.1% year-on-year rise in Q2FY27 revenue to Rs 24,752.7 crore, while net profit fell 1.9% to Rs 3,201 crore. The IT major expects Q3 revenue growth of -1.5% to 0.5% sequentially in constant currency terms. Nomura retained its Buy rating with a Rs 200 target, citing a slight revenue beat and confidence in delayed large deals closing.

item.title: Jio IPO: Meta, Google sit on nearly ₹1 lakh crore paper profit & neither is selling
item.description: Meta Platforms and Google are poised to realize significant gains from their Jio investment made in 2020. To bolster its growth, Jio Platforms is moving forward with an initial public offering planned to raise around ₹30,213 crore, achieving a valuation of ₹10.3 lakh crore. Neither Meta nor Google plans to divest shares in this round as existing backers maintain their stakes.

item.title: India's Yes Bank AT-1 ruling won't impact ratings despite earnings hit, S&P says
item.description: Yes Bank faced a setback as India's Supreme Court overturned its write-off of 84 billion rupees in bonds. S&P Global Ratings stated the ruling would not impact its credit rating of the bank. The decision highlights procedural errors in the 2020 write-down process, which regulators had supported. Despite this ruling, Yes Bank is expected to maintain adequate capitalization in the future.

item.title: Tech Mahindra shares gain 5% after Q2 results. Should you buy, sell or hold the stock?
item.description: Tech Mahindra share price: Tech Mahindra shares rose after Q2FY27 net profit increased 32.7% year-on-year to Rs 1,586 crore. Nomura retained its Neutral rating, seeing limited upside despite expectations of above-peer growth in FY27, driven by large telecom deals and expansion across other verticals.

item.title: NSE, BSE, Groww, other capital market stocks rise up to 3% as Sebi revises CAS framework. What traders must know
item.description: SEBI has revised the Closing Auction Session framework, changing market timings, order transfer rules and settlement price calculations for derivatives. The updated rules will take effect from December 7, 2026, with provisions for transferring unexecuted limit and iceberg orders kicking in on February 8, 2027.
